candidate.definition_en: A part of a tree growing from the trunk; or a local office of a company.
candidate.explanation_ar: ممكن يكون غصن شجرة، وممكن يكون فرع لشركة أو بنك في مكان معين.

senses.definition_en: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk.
examples: The bird sat on a branch.

senses.definition_en: A local office or shop belonging to a larger company or organization.
senses.definition_ar: فرع لشركة أو مؤسسة أو بنك
examples: Our bank has a branch near my house.

senses.definition_en: A part or division of a broader subject or system.
senses.definition_ar: فرع أو قسم من علم أو مجال معين
examples: Botany is a branch of biology.
The bird sat on a branch.
Our bank has a branch near my house.
Botany is a branch of biology.
candidate.mnemonic: تخيل إنك بتعمل 'Brunch' 'فطار متأخر' تحت الـ 'Branch' 'فرع' الشجرة.
